correctness.rationale: Adjunction for a smooth (2,2,2,2) complete intersection in P^5 yields K=O_C(2), degree16 and genus17, with 17 canonical quadratic sections (X0²,X1² and 15 mixed monomials). At R0 the five odd-in-w sections w f_a(w²), slopes a=0,±1,±t, have vanishing orders 1,3,5,7,9 via Vandermonde. The remaining 12 even-w sections split into seven even-z and five odd-z terms. Their exact 7×7/5×5 jet determinants contain coprime factors Q(t) and P(t), respectively; the next minors are nonzero at each relevant root. Thus generic and exceptional 17-entry valuation sequences produce weights 23/27. Reciprocal polynomials prove same at R1. Direct exact-rational independent odd-jet determinant evaluations at t=2,3 and both even-jet determinants at t=2,3 matched the specified formulas, with independent polynomial gcd, squarefree, t=0,±1 exclusion, and 17-entry weight sums 23,27,27. These point checks are corroboration; full all-t proof is the formal binomial-series determinant identities and gcds in inspected VERIFY.py plus the geometric local-parameter argument. No square-root branch zero on fiber because forbidden parameters excluded.
residual_risks: The four determinant identities were verified independently at two ordinary t values and against inspected symbolic certificate algorithm; exhaustive all-t validity rests on correct polynomial symbolic identities rather than finite sample values. Result is only for R0,R1, not all branch fibers.
